notes.title: V1.5 — The One Where The Money Finally Makes Sense
notes.description: Revenue Outstanding no longer counts every line that has a date and a dream. If there's no invoice, it's not outstanding — it's a wish. Headline dropped from R142.6M to R2.8M. Turns out we weren't that rich. Disappointing, but accurate.

notes.title: Revenue Overdue: No Longer a Horror Movie
notes.description: Previously showed R55.9M overdue, which would have required some very awkward phone calls. Now correctly shows R606K. The difference? We stopped counting forecast payment dates from projects that haven't even sent an invoice yet. Revolutionary concept, we know.

notes.title: MS Project Called, We Answered
notes.description: The Project Plan tab now looks like it went to finishing school. Full toolbar with Add Task, Milestones, Indent, Outdent, Move Up/Down, and Delete — all with proper icons like a civilized application. WBS numbering, duration editing, baseline tracking, and a Gantt chart that actually syncs. Your mouse will feel important.

notes.title: Revenue Tab: Now With Actual UX
notes.description: KPI strip at the top so you can panic about outstanding revenue without scrolling. Status badges that change colour based on reality (green = money in bank, red = still praying). Inline editing, override indicators with blue dots, and a save bar that judges you if your comment is too short.

notes.title: Expenditure Tab: Budget Anxiety, Visualised
notes.description: Five KPI cards showing Budget, Actual, COS, Variance, and GP% — with red highlighting when you're over budget, because the numbers alone weren't stressful enough. Collapsible category groups, status badges, and override dots so you always know who changed what and can assign blame efficiently.

notes.title: In Bank Logic: Now Understands Colours
notes.description: Payment dates with red font colour mean 'forecast' not 'received'. The system used to count these as money in the bank, which was optimistic at best, delusional at worst. Now it checks font colour and confirmation flags across ALL dashboards consistently. Same truth, every screen.

notes.title: Null Legacy IDs: No Longer a Death Sentence
notes.description: Tasks created through Smart Import without a legacy mapping used to be completely uneditable — like a PDF of a spreadsheet screenshot. Fixed with a 3-level lookup fallback. Your tasks are no longer orphans.

notes.title: Easter Egg: Still Here
notes.description: We didn't remove it. We didn't even look at it. Some things are sacred.
